scope: Published Graph versus actual standalone owned Motion; exact integer-frame control points13/41, foreign event splits, odd caller blocks, three rates, save/reload/reset/independent handles, late controls clamp to current frame, raw complete-config enforcement, outer-render peak scope, and actual one/three-worker master parity at48/96 kHz. Native seconds import and native browser numerical evidence remain distinct.
clock: Owned Motion and Graph apply exact integer-frame events; native step seconds require explicit native-step-ceil-v1 preparation before enqueue.
